description: This file defines system capabilities related to privileges in Kubernetes, including structures, initialization, setup, reset, and retrieval functions for capabilities and privileged sources.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Represents the set of system capabilities, including privilege allowance, privileged sources, and bandwidth limit.

classes.name: PrivilegedSources
classes.description: Defines sources from which privileged requests are allowed, such as host network, PIDs, and IPC.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the capabilities singleton once per binary execution.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Convenience wrapper around Initialize to set privilege allowance and bandwidth limit.

methods.name: ResetForTest
methods.description: Resets the capabilities singleton for testing purposes.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current system capabilities.
